functionDeclarations.name: web_search
functionDeclarations.description: Searches the live web for facts, news, documentation, curriculum, companies, marketplaces, AI model comparisons, or information. REQUIRED for explicit web research/search requests and current/latest facts that may have changed. Call for requests in Bangla, Banglish, or English. Always write the semantic search query in concise English; preserve exact names, URLs, quoted titles, and other literal identifiers. Do not answer a current-facts request from memory if this function was not called. Do NOT call this tool for weather (use get_weather) or local computer files (use list_directory/read_file).

query.description: Use a short focused query for one research subject and criterion, e.g. 'Google latest Gemini models official', 'OpenAI latest GPT models official', or 'Bangladesh NCTB English for Today Class 9 10 textbook units'. Do not anchor a latest-model lookup to model names from memory. Compare after retrieving current evidence for both subjects.

refresh.description: Set true only when the user explicitly asks to search again or refresh this lookup. This bypasses Orvix's local five-minute query cache; it does not guarantee that the provider has newer results.
